valores.label: Proposed date for Wasilla to become the capital (Jan. 1, 1997)

legenda: Ballot Measure No. 3 (93MCAP), 1994: two sections, no cost figure.
texto_para_tela: WASILLA · AS OF JANUARY 1, 1997 · NO PRICE ON THE BALLOT
narracao: The move came back in 1994. The new site was Wasilla… and the ballot carried no price. In the official election pamphlet, supporters said Wasilla was on the road system.

conferencia.item: Wasilla a partir de 1º/1/1997; sem preço
conferencia.localizador: p. B-24 (PDF p. 5), 'Ballot Language' e 'Full Text of Proposed Law'
conferencia.prova: "This initiative would amend state law to change the state capital from Juneau to Wasilla as of January 1, 1997."; o texto integral tem duas seções e nenhum custo (também AG 1993, p. 2)
"Wasilla is an established community, centrally located on the road system between Fairbanks and Kenai Peninsula…"
